label: Thomas Aquinas, Summa theologiae I q.2 a.3…: The sentence 'there is evil in the world' is true
locator: I q.2 a.3 obj. 1: Invenitur autem malum in mundo
interpretation: The minor premise of the objection from evil, read as asserting the evil premise as true. This is the external form's premise: the objector asserts that there is evil, not merely that his opponent believes so. Aquinas grants it (q.48 a.2); O'Connor's emotivism cannot (see the result against emotivism).
